Document​

GET/document/documents/{documentId}/attachment-urlPOST/document/documents/{documentId}/commit

Get document attachment upload url​

GET
/document/documents/{documentId}/attachment-url

Get presigned URL for document attachment upload

document_Oauth2

authorizationCode Flow

Token URL"http://authentik.notopia.localhost/application/o/token/"

  • "profile"Access to user profile
  • "email"Access to user email
password Flow

Samples​

Commit document​

POST
/document/documents/{documentId}/commit

Creates a revision of the current content. Requires write permission. Plus/pro workspaces also auto-commit (auto_commit), so this is only needed to force a revision earlier.

Authorizations​

document_Oauth2

OAuth2 Security Scheme

  • "profile"Access to user profile
  • "email"Access to user email
password Flow
Token URL"http://authentik.notopia.localhost/application/o/token/"
Scopes:
  • "openid"Required for OIDC
  • "profile"Access to user profile
  • "email"Access to user email
or
document_OIDC

OpenID Connect Security Scheme

Type

Revision​

Document revisions

Operations​

GET/document/revisionsGET/document/revisions/{revisionId}DELETE/document/revisions/{revisionId}POST/document/revisions/{revisionId}/rename

Get revisions​

GET
/document/revisions

Revisions older than the plan revision_history_days are purged daily; the latest is always kept. Filter with trigger.

100

20
excludeMemberInWorkspaceId
